Mutations in ABCC8 (encoding the SUR1 subunit of the KATP channel) lead to its dysfunction. In familial hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia 1, this directly results in persistent KATP channel opening, leading to insulin hypersecretion and hypoglycemia.
